packet.decision_constraints: Choose a next acquisition comparison while retaining frequency-only authority.
packet.supported_facts: Rife/Barankin threshold caution, Kay block estimate, lag tradeoff and Doppler-spread abstract motivate stationary versus time-varying comparisons.
packet.contrary_evidence_limits: Doppler multiplicative noise is not proven equivalent to oscillator drift; peer-review labels S1–S5 are unverified despite publication metadata.
packet.expert_question: Does time variation negate longer coherent support, and is lag range adequate?
packet.cheapest_falsifier: Use matched stationary/time-varying PCM with reset controls and measure error tails and absence admissions.
packet.consequential_rejections: Do not treat invented planning targets as measured requirements or immediately expand to ESPRIT/MUSIC/EKF.

stage_rows.original_claim: A small local variance bound or finite uncertainty number cannot alone establish low error probability at acquisition: single-tone ML/block estimators have a threshold region where errors can depart sharply from the local CRB.
